text_en: Solomon began to build the house of the Lord in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the Lord had appeared to his father David, at the place that David had designated, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
text_cn: 撒罗满在耶路撒冷，即在他父亲达味看见异像的摩黎雅山上，在耶步斯人敖尔难的禾场上，达味所准备的地方，兴工建造上主的圣殿。

text_en: He began to build on the second day of the second month of the fourth year of his reign.
text_cn: 撒罗满在即位后第四年二月兴工建造。

text_en: These are Solomon’s measurements for building the house of God: the length, in cubits of the old standard, was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.
text_cn: 撒罗满为建造天主圣殿的基地，按照古尺度计算：长六十肘，宽二十肘。

text_en: The vestibule in front of the nave of the house was twenty cubits long, across the width of the house; and its height was one hundred twenty cubits. He overlaid it on the inside with pure gold.
text_cn: 门廊的长度与圣殿的宽度相等，即二十肘，高二十肘，里面全贴上纯金。

text_en: The nave he lined with cypress, covered it with fine gold, and made palms and chains on it.
text_cn: 大殿里面先盖上一层木板，再贴上纯金，上面雕刻上棕树和花环；

text_en: He adorned the house with settings of precious stones. The gold was gold from Parvaim.
text_cn: 又以宝石点缀圣殿，甚是华丽；金子都是帕尔瓦因金。

text_en: So he lined the house with gold—its beams, its thresholds, its walls, and its doors; and he carved cherubim on the walls.
text_cn: 正殿、栋梁、门限、墙壁，以及门扇，都贴上金子，墙上刻有革鲁宾。

text_en: He made the most holy place; its length, corresponding to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and its width was twenty cubits; he overlaid it with six hundred talents of fine gold.
text_cn: 以后，建造了至圣所，长度与圣殿的宽度相等，即二十肘，宽度也是二十肘；内部贴了六百“塔冷通”纯金。

text_en: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
text_cn: 钉子重五十“协刻耳”金子；连楼阁也贴上了金子。

text_en: In the most holy place he made two carved cherubim and overlaid them with gold.
text_cn: 在至圣所内，以刻工刻了两个革鲁宾，外面包上黄金；

text_en: The wings of the cherubim together extended twenty cubits: one wing of the one, five cubits long, touched the wall of the house, and its other wing, five cubits long, touched the wing of the other cherub;
text_cn: 革鲁宾的翅膀，共长二十肘：这边革鲁宾的一个翅膀长五肘，伸至这边殿墙；另一个翅膀也长五肘，与另一个革鲁宾的翅膀相接连。

text_en: and of this cherub, one wing, five cubits long, touched the wall of the house, and the other wing, also five cubits long, was joined to the wing of the first cherub.
text_cn: 这一个革鲁宾的一个翅膀，也长五肘，伸至那边殿墙；另一个翅膀也长五肘，与前一个革鲁宾的翅膀相接连。

text_en: The wings of these cherubim extended twenty cubits; the cherubim stood on their feet, facing the nave.
text_cn: 两个革鲁宾的翅膀都伸开，共长二十肘；他们双足站立，面向圣殿。

text_en: And Solomon made the curtain of blue and purple and crimson fabrics and fine linen, and worked cherubim into it.
text_cn: 又用蓝线、紫线、朱红线和细麻，作了一帐幔，上面绣上革鲁宾。

text_en: In front of the house he made two pillars thirty-five cubits high, with a capital of five cubits on the top of each.
text_cn: 他又在殿前造了两根柱子，共长三十肘；每根柱子顶上有柱帽，高五肘。

text_en: He made encircling chains and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
text_cn: 又做了类似项链的花环，置于柱头上；又作了一百个石榴，悬在花环上。

text_en: He set up the pillars in front of the temple, one on the right, the other on the left; the one on the right he called Jachin, and the one on the left, Boaz.
text_cn: 把这两根柱子立在殿前，一左一右：右边的叫雅津，左边的叫波阿次。
